title: Nvidia drops 12%, Broadcom and AMD extend declines as the AI trade melts down
summary: Chip giant Nvidia slid further into red territory on Friday along with the rest of the semiconductor sector.

title: Sozzi: Anthropic’s IPO Surges; Is AMD’s Pullback a Buy?
summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the biggest stories to kick off the trading day, including the performance of Anthropic (ANT)’s IPO, whether AMD (AMD)’s pullback presents a buying opportunity, and Gap (GAP)’s fall earnings warning.

Sozzi then sits down with former Bridgewater (BWB) Associates Chief Investment Strategist Rebecca Patterson and former BNY (BNY) Wealth Management CEO Catherine Keating to discuss their new book, Investment Wisdom, and how its lessons can help friends and loved ones navigate investing.

title: Why the markets are being hit with a 'perfect storm' for AI
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down the bigger market story investors may have missed amid the frenzy surrounding Anthropic's (ANT) IPO: a broad sell-off in tech stocks. With the Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) falling 2%, the S&P 500  (^GSPC) closing lower, and chipmakers Nvidia (NVDA) and AMD (AMD) taking hits, Sozzi examines what's driving the weakness and what it could signal for investors

title: What to consider with AMD after reading short seller report
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi pushes back on a Hunterbrook Media report, noting it failed to show that AMD (AMD)–whose stock has stumbled in recent days–violated export law, an allegation the company has denied.

title: Mets Owner Steve Cohen’s Fund Dumped Nearly All of Its AMD and Bet $1 Billion That Microsoft Is the Safer AI Stock. AMD Has Fallen 31% Since
summary: Steve Cohen's Point72 sold 99% of its AMD shares in the third quarter and raised its Microsoft stake from 31,522 shares to 2,055,578, about $1 billion of buying, its Nov. 16 13F shows. AMD has fallen 31% since Sept. 30 and Microsoft 6%. The same filing tripled Intel, which has since lost more than half its value.

title: At AI Summit, Industry Titans Wave Off Market Woes—and Defend Jensen Huang
summary: Execs and investors at the TomorrowX conference in Austin, Texas, are as bullish as ever about AI’s ability to improve lives. The rest of America isn’t so sure.

title: Anthropic’s Day Two Drop Fuels Broader Tech Rout; Dan Ives Points To ‘Perfect Storm’
summary: Analyst Dan Ives attributed the selloff to a cluster of pressures including the Democratic “blue wave” midterm gains and resulting worries over anti-AI and data-center policies in key states.

title: The Fear Gauge Hit 40. This Is What the Market Is Worried About.
summary: Investors no longer believe the AI bull case. They fear an unwinding is coming.

title: Trump’s Treasury Secretary Keeps Nvidia’s H200 China Policy as House Data Show Nearly 880,000 AI Chips Approved
summary: Key TakeawaysHouse data show Commerce approved nearly 880,000 NVIDIA and AMD AI chips for China from December to May. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Friday he doesn’t expect the H200 policy to change.

title: Stock market today: Dow and S&P 500 enter correction, Nasdaq sinks 5% to erase 2026 gains as AI trade melts down
summary: Stocks are on track to post weekly losses after Nvidia earnings and Anthropic's IPO weren't enough for investors to shake off AI angst.
